text:
anna: Quick question — we need a clear platform stance on Dedicated traffic when Dedicated pools are saturated. Do we allow automatic overflow to Hosted, or do we enforce strict isolation by default? We need a product + API + console decision.

sam: My take: for enterprise tenants that pay for Dedicated SLA, overflow should be opt-in only. Default should be isolation unless customer explicitly opts in. Otherwise we break contracts / expectations. :no_entry:  

jia: Agree with opt-in. Also we need telemetry to show how often overflow happens and the cost delta. Customers will want chargeback visibility if their Dedicated traffic ever goes to Hosted.

sean: From an infra side we need two things: a circuit breaker per-tenant and clear metrics. Circuit breaker should trigger before we start routing to Hosted so we can surface degraded mode in console. Also fallback model variants are a separate axis (e.g. fallback to quantized variant on Dedicated before sending to Hosted).

marta: UX note — console toggle for "Allow Hosted overflow" should live under Dedicated > Capacity > Routing. It should be three-state: Opt-out, Opt-in (manual approval), Opt-in (auto with limits). Show recent overflow events and a cost preview.

anna: @marta typo — i meant @marta :)^ — good shape. Also we need an API flag so infra can make decisions: something like `routing_policy` on the request / tenant config.

sam: Something like this sketch for tenant config: 
```yaml
tenant_routing:
  preferred: dedicated
  overflow:
    enabled: false # tenant-level default
    mode: manual # manual | auto-with-limits | strict
    max_percent: 0.05 # when auto-with-limits, max frac of requests that can overflow
    model_fallbacks: ["quantized-v1", "cpu-variant"]
    billing: hosted
```
This covers policy + billing semantics.

jia: Important: `billing: hosted` must be explicit if overflow happens so invoices don't surprise customers. We also need per-request attribution metadata in telemetry: `orig_tenant`, `served_by` (dedicated|hosted), `fallback_variant`, `overflow_reason`.

sean: For circuit breaker heuristics: prefer token-based errors (OOM, queue_time > threshold), then throughput saturation. We should expose a `breaker_state` event stream so Console and Alerts can subscribe. Example event: `tenant:1234 breaker_state=tripped reason=queue_latency_ms>700 window=30s`

marta: UI snippets — console should show a mini-timeline: green = on Dedicated, amber = degraded (using local fallbacks), red = overflow to Hosted. Clicking an overflow event should show request samples (anonymized) and a one-click rollback to strict isolation.

anna: Security question from legal: can we ever route PII workloads to Hosted? If tenant uses Private KMS / dedicated key, overflow must not send plaintext to Hosted. Maybe we mark some tenants as "no-hosted" at the control-plane level.

sam: Yes, we need tenant-level enforcement flags: `allow_hosted_routing: true|false`. For Private/KMS customers default to false. For Dedicated customers default false unless explicitly enabled in contract.

jia: Implementation tasks I see: 1) telemetry schema update (add served_by, fallback_variant, overflow_reason), 2) billing hook for hosted-charge attribution, 3) dashboard widgets. I'll own telemetry.

sean: Infra tasks: 1) per-tenant circuit breaker + metrics, 2) routing policy enforcement in router, 3) implement fallback ordering (dedicated->dedicated-variant->hosted). I'll own router + CB.

marta: Product/UX: prototype console toggle + timeline, copy for billing disclosure, and a small banner in rollout UX to warn before enabling. I'll mock by Friday.

anna: Sounds like consensus: default strict isolation for Dedicated; overflow = opt-in with explicit billing flag; provide circuit breaker, telemetry fields, and console visibility + per-tenant enforcement for KMS/no-hosted. Action items assigned above.

infra-bot: deploybot: Routing changes PR queued -> `pr/infra/routing/overflow-logic` CI passed, awaiting code review. :rocket:

sam: One more internal API note — we should add a read-only admin endpoint `/internal/v1/tenants/:id/routing_status` that returns the current breaker_state, recent_overflow_count, and last_fallback_variant. Useful for support and SRE runbooks. Example response (concept):
```json
{
  "breaker_state": "closed",
  "recent_overflow_count": 2,
  "last_fallback_variant": "quantized-v1"
}
```

jia: I'll wire the telemetry to that endpoint. Also add event hooks for alerts.

anna: OK let's document this in the product spec doc and mark as WIP. I'll open the spec PR and link infra/product owners. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

marta: +1, will add mock screenshots to the PR.

sean: putting a note on the runbook: if a tenant reports "unexpected hosted charges" check `allow_hosted_routing` and `overflow_events` first.

anna: End — filing action items in the tracker now.
